title: Rust: B.2.1 Small Bounded Queues
description: Implement 4-packet TX queue, 2-per-source forwarding limits with QueueFull error returns.
close_reason: Rust TX queue is 4 packets (TX_QUEUE_CAPACITY) with QueueFull in rust/lichen-core/src/tx_queue.rs; forwarding is 2 packets per source / 8 sources in rust/lichen-node/src/forward_buffer.rs. cargo test -p lichen-core --lib tx_queue 39 passed; --test bufferbloat_vectors capacity+forwarding oracle passed.
